purpose: Test whether the descriptive animal-versus-plant robust-patch recovery-lift contrast can be identified after balancing pre-outcome observation architecture in the already frozen 96-pair Japanese confirmation cohort.

source_cohort.design: 12 region cells × 2 taxon groups × 4 historical record-count strata

observation_balance_model.model: L2 logistic regression, C=1, standardized nuisance metrics
observation_balance_model.group_normalization: weights normalized to mean 1 separately within animal and plant

pre_outcome_overlap_gate.if_fail: observation_architecture_not_balanceable_in_current_cohort; do not open pair-level recovery outcomes in this diagnostic run
pre_outcome_overlap_gate.if_pass: authorize one fixed weighted outcome decomposition

outcome_decomposition_if_authorized.primary_estimand: stabilized-IPW animal minus plant mean pair-level 10-km recovery lift
outcome_decomposition_if_authorized.raw_context: also report the original unweighted animal-minus-plant mean difference
outcome_decomposition_if_authorized.uncertainty: 5000 bootstrap resamples of the 48 region_name × record_count_stratum matched cells; refit propensity and recompute gate-compatible weighted contrast in each resample

interpretation.supports_taxon_residual_if: overlap gate passes AND weighted 95% bootstrap interval lower bound > 0
interpretation.observation_architecture_explains_or_obs: overlap gate passes but weighted interval includes 0

prohibited: reinterpret the original ACSP confirmation as a preregistered animal-versus-plant test
retune nuisance metrics or overlap thresholds after metadata are opened
drop taxa to improve overlap except incomplete metadata under the frozen minimum rule
fetch row-level coordinates for observation matching
change the validated 2.5% ACSP support method
claim causal biological differences between animals and plants from this retrospective diagnostic
